newsitem.title: CHINA: China listed firms slow to post results.
newsitem.headline: China listed firms slow to post results.

text.p: Only 38 of 530 listed firms have so far issued their 1996 annual results with half of the reporting season passed and a deadline of April 30 drawing near, the Shanghai Securities News said on Friday.

Most of the firms that have posted results early have reported strong 1996 growth, giving rise to a feeling among investors that the later a company issues its annual report, the worst the results will be, the newspaper said.
"Half of the reporting season has passed with only a limited number of listed firms having issued 1996 results. This has been noted by the market," the newspaper said.
